proposed_paths.create_only_if: A named duplicated owner decision or boundary dependency is removed. Default is retain current reads; the flat view alone does not remove PauseMenu's full session dependency.
One real route has accepted identity, legacy-origin, publication/activation and old/new coexistence policy.

observations.summary: Compensation can fail; in-flight previous-runtime reapply return is unobserved; some UI callers collapse outcomes. No runtime witness.
Serialized whole candidates can replace newer same-profile data. All writers need actual persisted bases and explicit preference intent.
Absent V2 UUID does not bind legacy origin; different UUIDs can change association matching. Concurrent imports need a policy.
Radio importer omits gamepad-only smoke; UI importer ignores returned read and skipped-section errors.
Distinguish retired-activity commands from legitimate current-state reconciliation; launch already has a target guard.
Quad throttle_cut appears applicable without a demonstrated consumer; real assignment/save/dispatch witness pending. Pause has GCA-01 scope.
Direct smoke lacks calibration-equivalent live uniqueness recheck; duplicate arrival witness pending.

work_packages.deliverable: Characterize real PauseMenu and existing intent; extraction needs a concrete eliminated decision/dependency
Prove selected fixed-wing consumer; retain existing route if sufficient, add projection/wrapper only when justified
After affected owner repairs, move one input/persistence seam without mixed behavior change
Separate helicopter/airship/quad adoption only when useful; ground optional
Profile attributed input workload after correctness
Qualify actual selected cohort and data rollback
